title: Bun.password (bcrypt)
notes: Bun.password.hashSync with algorithm bcrypt and cost 8, then verifySync on each of the two candidates. The hash is returned with the two booleans so the verifier can check cost and salt. Bun only.
details: Bun.password.hashSync with algorithm bcrypt and cost 8, then Bun.password.verifySync on each of the two candidates. The hash is returned with the two booleans so the verifier can check its cost and salt. Bun only.
